Client. A registered tax accountant about to receive CPA registration, which changes the firm's name. About 400 clients: mostly Canadian personal tax, then US taxpayers living in Canada (the niche to target), then a smaller corporate group. Works in Microsoft 365 with Copilot and SharePoint.
